releases.name: SwarmOS v0.5.0 — PageRank RepoMap, Circuit Breaker, Checkpoints, Memory & PTY Tap
releases.body:
SwarmOS v0.5.0 extends the Omni-Harness with codebase intelligence, resilience, and memory. Four new subsystems plus a dev-server log tap.

## Highlights

### 🗺️ PageRank RepoMap — `src/omni/repomap.ts`
A PageRank-weighted repository map that scans imports, computes per-file centrality, and exposes the reverse-import **blast radius** so agents know which files a change can ripple into before editing.

### ⚡ Doom-Loop Circuit Breaker — `src/omni/circuit-breaker.ts`
Detects repeated edit/shell failures within a session and trips a circuit breaker, halting further attempts instead of burning turns in a loop.

### ⏳ Time-Travel Checkpoints — `src/omni/checkpoints.ts`
Zero-git-noise checkpoints that snapshot file state and roll back cleanly — no stash, no dirty worktree, no commit churn.

### 🧠 Episodic Memory — `src/omni/memory.ts`
Cross-session lessons persisted to `.opencode/memory/lessons.json`, so knowledge gained in one session carries forward to the next.

### 🖥️ PTY Log Tap — `src/omni/pty-tap.ts`
Reads dev-server logs (by PTY id or log file) with error-only filtering, giving agents fast access to runtime failures.

## Also
- `/omni` command now surfaces checkpoints, episodic memory, and research sources alongside artifacts (`src/commands/omni.ts`).
- New tests in `test/omni.test.ts` covering RepoMap centrality/blast radius, circuit breaking, checkpoint rollback, episodic memory, and PTY log filtering.

## Verification
- `bun run typecheck` — 0 errors
- `bun test` — 40 pass / 0 fail across all 6 suites
- `bun run build` — regenerated `dist/index.js`, `dist/swarmos.standalone.js`, `dist/index.d.ts`, and `swarmos-plugin.ts`

**Full diff:** [`v0.4.0...v0.5.0`](https://github.com/Heretek-AI/SwarmOS/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0)
